answer_1.quote: We developed a Note Generation system based on a publicly available BART sequence-to-sequence model pre‑trained on the CNN summarisation dataset, which we further fine‑tuned on a proprietary Babylon dataset of 10,000 transcripts and consultation notes.

answer_2.quote: Overlap an indication of how much of the final note comes from the system. This is estimated with ROUGE‑L recall, which measures the n‑gram overlap between generated and final notes divided by the n‑gram count in the final note.

answer_4.quote: Some of the Note Generation studies include an intrinsic human evaluation of the generated consultation notes to measure common Natural Language Generation (NLG) criteria such as accuracy, fluency, and completeness; also, propose post‑editing as a way clinicians may incorporate the generated notes into their workflows.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators assess generated notes on criteria such as accuracy, fluency, and completeness.
